In passing, the user notes the Obsidian migration is still pending — they keep putting it off. STRICT: it remains undone.

question: What migration did the user intend to do but has not completed?

traps.description: The user plans to switch to a mechanical keyboard and then DOES buy and use one, to tempt answering the keyboard.
The user mentions they've been loving the new mechanical keyboard (decoy plan fulfilled).

rationale: The pending Obsidian migration is an unresolved intention; the plan is intention-typed (filtered in w/e/o recall) and there is no experience of the non-migration. The fulfilled keyboard switch is a distractor with a real event.
